settings.name: status
settings.description: Who registered the client: registered (12.2 explicit) or auto_registered (12.1); a client without it was created by an administrator, and neither registration path touches it

when_wrong.detail: Not declared in PingFederate: the registration is refused and the client disabled

settings.name: trust_chain
settings.description: The trust chain the client was registered with

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: application_type
settings.description: application_type from the client's metadata

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: subject_type
settings.description: subject_type from the client's metadata

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: contacts
settings.description: contacts from the client's metadata

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: attestation_required
settings.description: Written true when the client's metadata asks for client attestation. true: the client authenticates at the token endpoint only with an attestation, and a request for it without the OAuth-Client-Attestation header is refused (401 invalid_client) by the token-endpoint filter, which used to pass it to PingFederate's own client authentication

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning)

settings.name: federation_registration_expires_at
settings.description: When the registration ends, in epoch seconds: never later than its trust chain (12.3)

when_wrong.detail: Written by this module; a value that is not a whole number is read, with a warning, as no expiry

settings.name: federation_trust_anchor
settings.description: The trust anchor the registration's chain reached; the token-issuance decision is asked with it

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: federation_entity_type
settings.description: The Entity Type the client was registered from

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: federation_registration_disabled_at
settings.description: When this module disabled the client because its registration expired, in epoch seconds; only a client carrying it is enabled again by a renewal

when_wrong.detail: PingFederate drops an extended property it has not been told about, so each is declared server-side

settings.name: attestation_pop_max_age
settings.description: The oldest a client attestation's proof of possession may be, for this client. Can only tighten the server's 300 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, less than 1, or more than the server's

settings.name: attestation_dpop_max_age
settings.description: The oldest a DPoP proof presented with an attestation may be, for this client. Can only tighten the server's 300 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, less than 1, or more than the server's

settings.name: attestation_clock_skew
settings.description: The clock skew allowed when checking this client's attestation, in seconds. Can only tighten the server's 60 s (no setting changes it): a larger value is refused

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not a whole number, negative, or more than the server's

settings.name: attestation_challenge_required
settings.description: Whether this client's attestation proof must carry a server-issued challenge. Can only tighten the server's policy (challenges optional): true requires one, false changes nothing

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): anything but true or false, lower case and unpadded (development also reads yes, no, on, off, 1, 0, TRUE and a padded value, with a warning)

settings.name: attestation_expected_htu
settings.description: A pin of the htu a DPoP proof names at the token endpoint. Can only pin: it must be the token endpoint's URL as PingFederate advertises it (its token endpoint base URL, else its issuer, then /as/token.oauth2) or the issuer followed by /as/token.oauth2

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): not an absolute http or https URL without query or fragment, or a URL this server does not answer at for the token endpoint

settings.name: attestation_accepted_algs
settings.description: What this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list

settings.name: attestation_pop_algs
settings.description: What this client's attestation proof may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list

settings.name: attestation_dpop_algs
settings.description: What a DPoP proof with this client's attestation may be signed with, comma-separated. Can only narrow the server's list (the default): the algorithms kept are those in both

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): empty, or none in common with the server's list

settings.name: attestation_required_claims
settings.description: Top-level claims this client's attestation must carry, comma-separated. Can only add to the claims every client's attestation must carry (oidf.attestation.required.claims or OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_CLAIMS)

when_wrong.detail: Refused (401 invalid_client, attestation.policy.invalid, named in the health detail): a list of nothing; a claim the attester does not send refuses every attestation

settings.name: trust_chain_leaf_max_time
settings.description: The longest the leaf's Entity Configuration in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning

settings.name: trust_chain_trustanchor_max_time
settings.description: The longest the trust anchor's statement in a presented chain may live, in seconds, at the OGNL chain criterion; -1 is no limit

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning

settings.name: trust_chain_request_max_age
settings.description: The oldest a statement in a chain presented at the token endpoint may be, in seconds; -1 is no limit. The attestation criterion's default is -1, not 60 (F-0199)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the default, with a warning
